Vellmoor Bridge

Vellmoor Bridge
Crosses River Alder
Opened 1893
Material Wrought iron
Span 112 metres

Vellmoor Bridge is a wrought iron arch bridge that carries a minor road across the River Alder. It was designed by the engineer Ottilie Brandt and is regarded as a fine example of late Victorian practical design.

Contents: 1 History, 2 Dimensions, 3 Legacy

History

Construction began in the spring of 1891 after the previous timber crossing was swept away by floodwater. Local ironworks supplied nearly all of the structural members.

Dimensions

Feature Measurement
Main arch rise nineteen metres
Deck width six metres
Rivets used approximately forty thousand

Legacy

The bridge was closed to heavy vehicles in 1974 and now serves pedestrians and cyclists. A conservation charity maintains it with donations from visitors.
